ui.clic_droit_reassocier_avec_on_ou_off_: · Right-click: rebind with ON or OFF
ui.afficher_la_derniere_page_de_la_seque: Show the last page after all piston movements.
ui.ajouter_off_retire_seulement_le_signa: Add OFF: remove only mod power. Clicking again with the tool removes the action.
ui.ajouter_on_avec_l_objet_repeter_le_cl: Add ON. Clicking again with the tool removes the action on this page.
ui.appuyer_sur_une_touche_ou_cliquer_ave: Press a key or click a mouse button. Escape: unbind.
ui.arreter_la_lecture_en_direct_et_retir: Stop live playback and remove mod power. U in the world. Blocks are not reset.
ui.basculer_entre_ouverture_et_fermeture: Switch between Opening and Closing. Closing starts after Opening; construction is shared.
ui.capturer_le_montage_autour_de_vous_ra: Capture the circuit around you (radius 8 to 31 blocks) and save your inventory before giving tools. Include the entire circuit.
ui.choisir_une_sequence_puis_capturer_ou: Choose a sequence, then Capture or Preview.
ui.conflit_avec_une_autre_commande_minec: Conflicts with another Minecraft control. Choose another binding.
ui.creer_une_animation_pour_commencer_0e: Create an animation to get started.
ui.en_tete_aller_a_la_page_cellule_progr: Header: go to page · cell: program · right-click: remove
ui.erreur_le_rayon_doit_etre_un_entier_e: Error: radius must be an integer from 8 to 31.
ui.gestion_verrouillee_pendant_la_sessio: Management is locked during the session.
ui.glisser_le_curseur_ou_utiliser_la_mol: Drag or scroll: text and buttons scale together. Applied when returning. Zoom is limited on small screens.
ui.gerer_les_animations_choisir_creer_et: Manage animations: select, create and rename. End the session before changing animations.
ui.jouer_l_ouverture_depuis_l_etat_reel_: Play Opening from the current world state, without restoring or pausing. Stop removes mod power.
ui.jouer_l_ouverture_depuis_son_depart_r: Play Opening from its start. R returns to the start and pauses.
ui.jouer_la_fermeture_depuis_l_etat_reel: Play Closing from the current world state; run Opening first if needed.
ui.jouer_la_fermeture_depuis_le_resultat: Play Closing from the result of Opening. R returns to the start and pauses.
ui.layout_debugger_doit_etre_present_sur: Layout Debugger must be installed on the server.
ui.le_zoom_agrandit_ou_reduit_tout_bouto: Zoom scales everything: buttons, text and timeline. Applied when returning; other Minecraft menus keep their scale.
ui.lecture_pause_u_ou_espace_dans_cet_ec: Play / pause: U or Space in this screen. R: reset and pause. Bindings can be changed in Settings.
ui.lire_la_sequence_sans_entrer_en_captu: Preview the sequence without capturing: pages, playback, pause, reset and end. Your inventory is unchanged.
ui.maintenir_l_alimentation_du_mod_jusqu: Keep mod power active until an OFF action.
ui.masquer_l_interface_pour_utiliser_les: Hide the interface to use tools. The editing session stays active. K reopens the timeline.
ui.nom_invalide_1_a_48_lettres_chiffres_: Invalid name: 1 to 48 letters, digits, _ or -.
ui.parametres_touches_taille_du_menu_et_: Settings: bindings, interface size and path warnings.
ui.recevoir_les_outils_on_et_off_clic_dr: Get ON and OFF tools. Right-click a piston to program the current page.
ui.rejouer_jusqu_a_cette_page_page_0_dep: Replay up to this page. Page 0 is the start; one page is one redstone tick.
ui.retirer_uniquement_le_signal_du_mod_l: Remove only mod power. Real redstone still works.
ui.reglage_de_la_sequence_capturee_maj_c: Setting for the captured sequence. Shift + right-click with ON/OFF ignores a position.
ui.saisir_un_nom_libre_pour_creer_une_an: Enter an unused name to create an animation with two timelines.
ui.selectionner_une_animation_puis_saisi: Select an animation, then enter a new unused name. End the session before renaming.
ui.terminer_restaurer_le_montage_initial: Finish: restore the modified initial construction, your inventory and the previous pause state. Actions stay saved.
ui.terminer_la_session_ou_arreter_la_lec: End the session or stop playback before changing animations.
ui.version_ou_fonctions_du_pont_paper_in: Incompatible Paper bridge version or capabilities.
ui.visionnage_pages_naviguer_0_depart_fi: Preview · pages: navigate · 0: start · End: last page
ui.voir_reordonner_ou_supprimer_les_acti: View, reorder or remove actions on this page.
ui.ordre_au_meme_tick_supprimer_molette_: ↑ ↓: order within a tick · ×: remove · wheel: list
ui.shared_hint: The page indicates applied actions; the world keeps running.
msg.sequence_created: Sequence created. Capture the circuit to get started.
msg.choose: Choose or create an animation in the manager.
msg.empty: Choose or create a sequence to get started.
msg.capture: Initial state captured. Page 0; select a tool and click a piston.
msg.preview: Preview mode. Choose a page or start playback.
msg.live_mode: Shared mode: replay at normal speed; the world keeps running.
msg.rights: Creative mode and Layout Debugger permission are required.
msg.bukkit_rights: Creative mode and layoutdebugger.use permission are required.
msg.pause: Pause playback and wait for the page calculation to finish.
msg.wait_piston: Wait for piston movements to finish before capturing: {0}
msg.warning: Block on a piston path: {0} ({1}). Advisory warning.
msg.regional: Regional preview: isolate the circuit from its surroundings; global time and entities are not rewound.
msg.random: The region contains blocks with random ticks; their evolution cannot be reproduced exactly.
msg.aim: Aim at a piston present in the initial capture.
msg.duplicate: This name is already in use: {0}
msg.needcapture: Capture the circuit in the editor first.
msg.renamebusy: Finish capturing or previewing before renaming an animation.
msg.readonly: Preview mode: finish previewing, then capture to edit the sequence.

msg.bounds: The capture area and its margin must be loaded and ticking. Move closer or reduce the radius.
msg.live: Live playback: the world keeps running.
msg.complete: Actions finished; power held. Open/Close continues from the current state; Stop removes power.
msg.entity_note: Entities are allowed and are not rewound.
msg.no_modify: Building is unavailable during playback or replay. Pause or finish previewing.
msg.tools_space: Free two inventory slots, then click Tools.
ui.wait_for_page: Wait for the page to finish loading before clicking again.
